GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta.description_en:
This API retrieves the metadata needed to upload a file as a work item attachment. It is the first of three steps:\
1. Call this API to get the upload information.\
2. Use the information in the response to upload the file to Object Storage Service (OSS).\
3. Call the `WorkitemAttachmentCreate` API to associate the uploaded file with the work item.\
\
For step 2, refer to the OSS documentation at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31926.html. The request must use the `POST` method and be submitted as a form.\
\
\
\
\
GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta.description_zh:
获取工作项附件上传的信息接口，这是工作项上传附件中的第一步。整个过程需要完成三步，
第一步，调用该接口获取工作项的上传信息。
第二步，根据该接口的返回信息将文件上传到oss中。
第三步，将文件作为工作项的附件，对应的接口为 WorkitemAttachmentCreate(关联文件为工作项的附件)

第二步上传文件时可以参考oss的文档：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31926.html，
注意请求为POST方法，数据是表单提交的方式

SkipPipelineJobRun.description_zh: 可以跳过流水线任务运行

StopPipelineJobRun.description_en: You can stop a pipeline job from running.
StopPipelineJobRun.description_zh: 可以终止流水线任务运行

StopPipelineRun.description_en: You can stop a pipeline run

StopVMDeployOrder.description_en: You can stop a machine deployment

TransferRepository.description_en: You can transfer a repository to a group using a full path for both `groupId` and `repositoryId`
TransferRepository.description_zh: 转移代码库至指定的代码组，其中groupId和repositoryId均可使用全路径

TriggerRepositoryMirrorSync.description_en: Trigger synchronization of a Codeup repository from a remote source after importing it from another platform
TriggerRepositoryMirrorSync.description_zh: 从其他平台导入到Codeup的仓库，触发Codeup仓库从远程同步

UpdateApplication.description_en: Updates the owner of an application

UpdateCheckRun.description_en: Only the writer of a check run can update it
UpdateCheckRun.description_zh: 更新check run记录信息，须当前身份与check run的写入人身份一致，才能进行更新

UpdateFile.description_en: Modify a file in the code repository

UpdateGroup.description_en: Updates a single group, identified by its `pathWithNamespace`
UpdateGroup.description_zh: 更新单个代码组信息，以pathWithNamespace作为唯一标识

UpdateGroupMember.description_en: Modifies the access level of a group member
UpdateGroupMember.description_zh: 修改组成员，主要是成员的权限修改

UpdateHostGroup.description_en: You can update a host group

UpdateMergeRequest.description_en: This API only supports updating the title and description of a merge request
UpdateMergeRequest.description_zh: 该API仅支持修改合并请求的标题和描述信息

UpdateMergeRequestPersonnel.description_en: Updates the personnel, such as reviewers or subscribers, for a merge request
UpdateMergeRequestPersonnel.description_zh: 更新合并请求的干系人，包含评审人、订阅人

UpdateOrganizationMember.description_en: Updates the details of a specified organization member

UpdatePipeline.description_en: This operation updates only YAML-based pipelines

UpdateProjectField.description_en: Update the project properties, custom fields, and project status
UpdateProjectField.description_zh: 更新项目自身属性与自定义字段，以及项目状态

UpdateProjectLabel.description_en: Updates a label in a repository

UpdateProtectedBranches.description_en: Modify protected branch settings. Supports detailed configuration of protected branch rules, including branch, push rules, merge rules, requiring code review before merging, and requiring automated status checks before merging
UpdateProtectedBranches.description_zh: 更改保护分支设置。 支持对于保护分支规则的详细设置，包括分支、推送规则、合并规则、要求合并前通过代码评审以及要求合并前通过自动化状态检查

UpdatePushReviewOnOff.description_en: Enables or disables the push review setting for a specified repository. This operation requires administrator permissions
UpdatePushReviewOnOff.description_zh: 打开或关闭指定代码库的推送评审设置（需要有管理员权限）

UpdatePushRule.description_en: This operation overwrites the specified push rule with the provided content. Therefore, to add a new rule item, you must include all existing rule items in the request; otherwise, they will be deleted
UpdatePushRule.description_zh: 更新指定的推送规则，更新方式为覆盖式更新，若是新增规则项，需要确保原有的也存在，否则会被新内容覆盖

UpdateRepository.description_en: Update basic information and common settings of the code repository
UpdateRepository.description_zh: 更新代码库基本信息、常用设置

UpdateRepositoryMember.description_en:
Updates the permission or role of a member in the current code repository based on the repository ID, User ID, and update content.  
Note: In the future, User ID will be unified as Alibaba Cloud account ID (aliyunPk). Please stay tuned
UpdateRepositoryMember.description_zh:
根据代码库ID（repositoryId）、用户ID（userId）以及更新内容，更改当前代码库下对应成员的权限或角色。
注意：后续会将用户ID统一为阿里云账号ID（aliyunPk），请注意关注

UpdateTestCase.description_en: Updates a test case's attributes in a test case library, including its title, directory, and custom fields, but not its test content
UpdateTestCase.description_zh: 更新用例库测试用例属性，包括标题，目录，自定义字段信息等，但是不能用来更新测试用例的测试内容相关信息

UpdateTestResult.description_en: This operation updates the execution status and executor for a test case in a test plan
UpdateTestResult.description_zh: 更新测试计划中的用例的执行状态和执行人

UpdateVariableGroup.description_en: You can update a variable group

UpdateWorkitemField.description_zh: 更新工作项字段，可以支持批量更新多个字段

WorkitemAttachmentCreate.description_en: Associates a file as an attachment of a work item. This is the third step of uploading an attachment to a work item. For the first two steps, refer to the description of the GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta (obtain the information for uploading attachments to work items) operation
WorkitemAttachmentCreate.description_zh: 将文件作为工作项的附件，这是工作项上传附件的第三步，前两步可以查看 GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta(获取工作项上传附件的信息) 接口的描述
